'''Holenesh Canyon''' was a [[kilometer]]-deep canyon on the [[planet]] [[Ilum]], which a strange [[The Force|Force]] [[Disturbance in the Force|anomaly]] was centered upon, manifesting in a fluctuation occurring about every one hundred [[standard year]]s. The canyon was located about five hundred [[kilometer]]s from the primary [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Jedi temple]] on the planet, where the entrance to the [[Crystal Cave]] was located. After its discovery by the [[Jedi]] [[Holenesh]], the [[Jedi Order]] established an [[Holenesh outpost|outpost]] at the end of canyon, naming it after its discoverer. The outpost once had a population of one hundred [[Sentience|sentients]] but was destroyed in an avalanche coinciding with the anomaly's reappearance.<ref name="NOP" />

Though some inhabitants of the outpost escaped the [[groundquake]], further seismic disturbances made rescue efforts impossible, and it was left abandoned underneath snow and fallen rock. Despite this, as [[time]] passed, further groundquakes and erosion exposed portions of the settlement, with the contents of the building still preserved over the [[Millennium|millennia]].<ref name="NOP" />
